A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe R4Det and contain corresponding text, equations, Figures 1–8, Tables 1–9, and supplementary Sections A–C. Text extraction and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original R4Det detection experiments on TJ4DRadSet and VoD, component ablations, and supplementary sensitivity analyses and visualizations.

after.justification: v2 retains those original detection results, component ablations, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same Panoramic Depth Fusion losses, DGTF alignment and gating, and IGDR instance-guided calibration. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use TJ4DRadSet and VoD for radar-camera 3D object detection, retaining the same respective object categories and challenging scenarios. No dataset, task, or evaluation environment is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain identical comparator membership, including SGDet3D and CVFusion. Table 3 retains the same BEVFusion and RCBEVDet comparisons with and without the proposed modules.

E3.justification: The reported splits, AP metrics, IoU thresholds, TJ4DRadSet evaluation range, training stages, batch size, and speed-testing setup are unchanged. Main-text and supplementary ablation settings also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the component ablations in Tables 4–7, loss-weight sensitivity in Table 8, historical-frame-gap sensitivity in Table 9, and qualitative detection, depth, and alignment analyses in Figures 6–8.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty estimates for the performance results. Both retain the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: All tabulated, plotted, and qualitative results are retained. R4Det remains at 47.29 3D mAP and 54.07 BEV mAP on TJ4DRadSet, and 66.69 EAA mAP and 83.68 driving-corridor mAP on VoD (Tables 1–2). Supplementary results also match.

T1.justification: Equations 1–21 and their mathematical definitions are unchanged, including the depth losses, dynamic pair-selection threshold, temporal updates, and instance calibration. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about depth estimation, pose-free temporal fusion, instance refinement, plug-and-play applicability, and state-of-the-art detection. The added release statement does not change the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of depth sharpness, gating, and instance calibration are retained. Appendix B keeps the same noise-accumulation interpretation for distant historical frames, and Appendix C retains its motion-alignment interpretation. No new limitations or qualifications appear.

D1.justification: The v2 abstract adds the GitHub repository address VDIGPKU/R4Det and promises a future source-code and model release; v1 lacks this disclosure. The PDFs do not establish that artifacts are already available. Implementation details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 29 cited works and related-work positioning are retained. Changes to citation-page backreferences reflect text reflow, not added or removed research.

P1.justification: v2 updates Yousen Tang’s email address and adds the release sentence to the abstract. Scientific prose, terminology, section order, and supplementary text otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Minor typesetting reflow changes column and page breaks and spacing around retained displays; the conclusion now continues onto page 9. Figures, tables, and captions retain their content and designs. The supplementary page is visually identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a location for a planned code/model release, but the PDFs do not establish released artifacts. With the methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, and appendices unchanged, this disclosure, the email update, and minor reflow leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
